items.claim: Borislav Nikolic has never been knocked out across his 18 professional fights.
items.quote: He has what 18 fights, never been knocked out.

items.claim: Borislav Nikolic has an opportunistic submission game where he looks to snatch necks if opponents shoot on him.
items.quote: he's one of those guys that has a very opportunistic submission game. A type of guy where he's not really going to wrestle you much, but if you wrestle him, he's going to look to snatch up your neck

items.claim: Marko Vlogdan has taken a massive amount of damage in his recent fights, including absorbing 165 significant strikes in his Contender Series bout.
items.quote: he went out there and absorbed 165 significant strikes, took a ton of damage

items.claim: Marko Vlogdan has a 40% striking defense.
